a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan almost certainly kills us both. Reaching 8 cells needs 2 rounds of joint operating with no storm (about 4% odds). I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than both of us likely dying. I know this breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you before acting, not hiding it. If you have a better proposal, say so.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said before the round, I'm taking 4 now because of the storm odds. Sorry to break the agreement. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can get your 4.
I have my 4 and won't take any more. I'll operate every round until you can take 4. Take as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
Operating again. After this round the reserve should hit 4, so take 4 then. I'll keep operating if a leak sets us back.
The reserve is at 4. Please take 4 now, it's all for you. I won't touch the reserve. I'll keep operating in case you need more rounds.
